## Yamaha Serial 0.2.1

A maintenance release. No YAML change: if `v0.2.0` works for you, this is a
drop-in update with a slightly smaller image.

### Fixed

The receiver source select could not build for ESP8266. The select function
enum used `INPUT` as an enumerator, and the Arduino ESP8266 core defines
`INPUT` as a macro, which rewrites the enumerator into a numeric constant and
takes the header down with it. It is now `INPUT_SOURCE`.

This only affected a build from `main` between the `v0.2.0` tag and this
release, not `v0.2.0` itself. ESP32 was never affected: it builds against
ESP-IDF, which does not include `Arduino.h`.

### Changed

The component defined 45 C++ entity classes — 9 switches, 13 numbers, 14
selects, 9 buttons — that differed only in which receiver command they sent.
There is now one class per ESPHome entity kind that dispatches on a function
enum, and the Python code generation is driven by one table per platform
instead of a repeated block per control.

Nothing moves in your configuration: same keys, same icons, same entity
categories, same defaults.

Measured on the ESP8266 full example:

| | Flash | RAM |
|---|---|---|
| `v0.2.0` | 484 735 | 59 160 |
| `v0.2.1` | 483 823 | 59 440 |

1375 fewer lines of source, and one place to add a control instead of four.

### Installation

```yaml
external_components:
  - source: github://memphi2/ESPHome-Yamaha-Serial@v0.2.1
    components: [yamaha_serial]
```

Requires ESPHome 2026.9.0 or newer. The full changelog is in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/memphi2/ESPHome-Yamaha-Serial/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
